summary: Recorded both accounts from the committed-value receipt and requested a fresh execution of the extended probe. The receipt 9b8471479d484a12bdaf961653bbbe54 showed the recovery still proposing the NOOP although replica 2's prepare reply carried X with Status COMMITTED (violated comparison 0, witness 19) and the recovering replica ending undecided (violated comparison 1, witness 21); the value-adoption account now cites both executed witnesses, and the status-guard mechanism has its own conditional account whose prediction is that the executor's retry would complete a NOOP commit contradicting the live committed X. The revision adds exactly that second startRecoveryForInstance attempt to the probe, and local native feedback already reproduced the prediction: the second attempt appends three replies and dispatches the accept phase, after which replica 3 and replica 4 end COMMITTED with the NOOP while replica 2 keeps X committed and the failed owner's log still records X - a completed contradiction of a committed value for the same instance. Declaration anchors, prerequisites and the agreement comparison are declared for the controller's receipt, which is still outstanding; the interpretation of that receipt remains unfinished work.
